einzeiler: A raccoon sneaks into the recording studio during a podcast and sparks sheer panic.
kurzfassung: While recording an episode in the studio, the hosts discover an unexpected visitor: a raccoon. Convinced the animal is seeking revenge for an old accident, the host panics and refuses to look at it. After some chaotic attempts to handle the situation, the animal eventually leaves with a tie.
stichpunkte: Social distancing rules limit in-studio guests to just the hosts.
A raccoon suddenly appears under the desk during the recording.
The host panics, claiming the animal is seeking revenge for a past hit-and-run.
Multiple bizarre weapons, including poison blow darts, are suggested to deal with the intruder.
The co-host attempts various distraction methods, including ASMR sounds.
The host urinates in the studio corner to mark his territory.
The raccoon eventually leaves on its own with a sixteen-hundred-dollar tie.
An interview with Bruno Mars has to be cancelled due to the chaos.

clips.hook: Six tranquilizer guns on the premises at all times
clips.text: The host explains that his contract requires multiple tranquilizer guns to be present during any of his appearances for crew and personal safety.

clips.hook: Driving down PCH listening to John Denver
clips.text: The host recounts driving along the coast while listening to music before accidentally hitting a raccoon.

clips.hook: Poison blow darts from a James Bond movie
clips.text: The host reveals he keeps a set of poison blow darts hidden in his car's glove compartment.

clips.hook: Marking my territory in the corner
clips.text: While hiding from the raccoon, the host admits to urinating in the corner of the room to establish dominance.
The co-host explains that the raccoon likely climbed up from a digital petting zoo downstairs where users look at pictures instead of real animals.

beschreibung:
A raccoon finds its way into the studio. We are dead serious. What the hell?
